# bundles

Add the notion of a bundle — a named set of scripts that can be installed on its own, "for example, git bundle". The dotfiles were one monolithic install: every script and alias landed on every machine, including work machines where only the git helpers were wanted. A bundle would let the installer (or `self-update`) pick groups: git, docker, mac, and so on.
